summary: QXO, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting final results of its subsidiary Titanium MergerCo's tender offers and consent solicitations for TopBuild Corp.'s 4.125% Senior Notes due 2032 and 5.625% Senior Notes due 2034. The offers expired June 29, 2026, with 99.54% of the 2032 Notes ($497.7M principal) and 99.75% of the 2034 Notes ($748.1M principal) tendered. Early-tendered notes were accepted at $1,011.25 per $1,000 principal plus interest; later-tendered notes at $961.25. Settlement is expected July 1, 2026. This high-acceptance tender reduces TopBuild's debt load, likely smoothing QXO's acquisition path. Watch for any remaining holdout notes and the close of the broader acquisition.
